External_Reference.reference_text: Retherford, K.D., Becker, T.M., Gladstone, G.R. et al. Europa Ultraviolet Spectrograph (Europa-UVS). Space Sci Rev 220, 89 (2024). https://doi.org/10.1007/s11214-024-01121-x
External_Reference.description: This paper describes the Europa-UVS investigation's science plans, instrument details, concept of operations, and data formats in the context of the Europa Clipper mission's primary habitability assessment goals.

Instrument.name: Europa Ultraviolet Spectrograph (Europa UVS)
Instrument.description: By collecting ultraviolet light with a telescope, and creating images, the Europa Ultraviolet Spectrograph will help determine the composition of Europa's atmospheric gases and surface materials. It will also search near Europa for signs of plume activity.
